Currently, the track is connected to the green block. Let me see if there's a way to "confirm" or "collect" it. Maybe I need to press LEFT to retract the track, or maybe I need to press ACTION7 or MOUSE.
Actually, let me look at this from a different angle. The track has connected to the green block. Maybe the next step is to move to the next block (red, which is above) and extend the track there.
